fields.description: Sobha Orbis is an apartment development in Dubai’s Motor City, offering one-bedroom, one-and-a-half-bedroom and two-bedroom layouts. Balconies, shared gardens and leisure spaces frame the homes. The half-bedroom options have their own drawings and should be assessed as a distinct configuration, rather than described as full two-bedroom apartments.

overview: The original Tower A plan pack contains one-bedroom Type A, a separate 1.5-bedroom range and two-bedroom layouts. Later project releases and tower-specific terms should not be collapsed into the original phase’s schedule.
research.locationNote: Motor City, Dubai, as described in the developer’s own project materials. No nearby district is substituted for the project address.
research.priceNote: The own developer page fetched on 31 October 2026 advertises AED 2,010,000 from, subject to inventory availability. This is a published guide, not a checked available unit, valuation or binding offer. Other historical launch advertisements may use a different price or unit mix.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder lists 20% booking, 60% construction and 20% handover, plus a separate 20/80 pre-completion option. Older broker brochures offer 60/40. The table shows one portal option, not a universal or current unit offer.
research.handoverNote: Developer catalogue: December 2027. Property Finder’s current key information says December 2028, while its older narrative still says Q4 2027. Confirm the particular tower’s current contractual date.
